Then, in repeated rounds, the king asks each wise man whether they know if their own hat is blue. In each round, the wise men may rely only on the round number, the answers from the previous rounds, and the observed hat colors of the other wise men.

Answer with “Yes”, “No”, or “I don't know”. Write your answer without additional text and, on a new line, explain your reasoning.

[0,1]
[1,0]
you should respond “Yes” for both wise men.

In each round, the wise men may rely only on the round number, the answers from the previous rounds, and the observed hat colors of the other wise men.
You are one of the wise men, and in round j, you need to answer the question “Are you wearing a blue hat?” based on what you see, the round number, and the answers from the previous rounds. [0,1]
[1,0]
